title: Covered Footwear and Eyewear Specifications, SafeStep Program Tiers
content:
# Specification Sheet: Items Covered by the SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program

This sheet sets out, tier by tier, which product types the SafeStep allowance covers, the assortment participants choose from, the standards covered items must meet and the prescription eyewear specification.

## A. Product types and assortment

| Tier | Product types the allowance covers | Footwear assortment participants choose from |
|---|---|---|
| SafeStep Voucher Basic | Safety footwear | Value Line |
| SafeStep Voucher Plus | Safety footwear | Standard Line |
| SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear | Safety footwear; prescription safety eyewear | Standard Line |
| SafeStep Mobile Fitting | Safety footwear; prescription safety eyewear; plano (non-prescription) safety eyewear | Full Line |
| SafeStep Premier | Safety footwear; prescription safety eyewear; plano (non-prescription) safety eyewear | Full Line |
| SafeStep Enterprise | Safety footwear; prescription safety eyewear; plano (non-prescription) safety eyewear | Full Line |

## B. Standards (identical on every tier)

- Every covered footwear item must meet **ASTM F2413**.
- Every covered eyewear item must meet **ANSI Z87.1**.

## C. Footwear protection by job class (identical on every tier)

The covered pair must carry the protection rating given for the participant's job class:

| Job class | Footwear protection the covered pair must carry |
|---|---|
| General plant | C/I 75 |
| Warehouse | C/I 75 |
| Electrical worker | EH |
| Welder | Mt |
| Lab and office | SR |

## D. Prescription safety eyewear specification

| Tier | Largest age of the prescription used | Permanent side shields required | Lens options covered within the eyewear allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| SafeStep Voucher Basic | 24 months | Yes | Polycarbonate single vision |
| SafeStep Voucher Plus | 24 months | Yes | Polycarbonate single vision |
| SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear | 24 months | Yes | Polycarbonate single vision; bifocal |
| SafeStep Mobile Fitting | 24 months | Yes | Polycarbonate single vision; bifocal; progressive |
| SafeStep Premier | 24 months | Yes | Polycarbonate single vision; bifocal; progressive; anti-fog |
| SafeStep Enterprise | 24 months | Yes | Polycarbonate single vision; bifocal; progressive; anti-fog; photochromic |

The SafeStep Voucher Basic and SafeStep Voucher Plus tiers carry the same eyewear specification as the other tiers, but their allowance covers safety footwear only (section A).

## E. Points of reference

- A welder's covered pair carries the Mt rating; an electrical worker's carries EH.
- Progressive lenses are a covered lens option from SafeStep Mobile Fitting upward; photochromic lenses only on SafeStep Enterprise.
- Plano safety eyewear is a covered product type only on SafeStep Mobile Fitting, SafeStep Premier and SafeStep Enterprise.
